Answer: C
Reason: The chest X-ray demonstrates multiple large, well-defined, round opacities (cannonball lesions) bilaterally, which is the classic radiographic appearance of pulmonary hydatid cysts (echinococcosis), particularly in a pediatric patient from an endemic area. While metastases can present similarly, the specific description of well-defined round lesions often associated with lower lobes and the demographic strongly favors hydatid disease in this context.
